texts.facts: The addresses mentioned in the affidavits are wrongly mentioned, leading us to question whether the actual Gharaunda site was ever inspected or not. No proper place, the building wherein the said facility is running is place of basically the ground floor of 30 60 feet house, which is nowhere near the prescribed 10,000 sq feet. No Kitchen Service, when the food is being outsourced, there is no question of feeding the residents timely. No adequate space for any physical activity outside for males or any equipment's to play indoor in female home too. The Management failed to / did not supplied copy of the register on time to check their financial use of money allotted to them. Attendance registers were prepared on the very same day, as it was very evident from the signature and pen used and even there was a signature mistakenly done for 17 days and it was stated that, speech doctor Dr. Agrawal does not visit to place some assistant visits some times and they send register to her clinic once in another to sign for entire month as it was told by the authority to the team. The Management failed / did not demonstrated and did not provide any clear answer about the occupancy of staff and their bed cloths. There were no sufficient cloths for the people to change daily after in both the male and female house. No food facility apart from the lunch and dinner to eat in between, as in for breakfast or evening snack. There is no physiotherapy room in either male or female facility. There is no Separate Patient Room for Primary Treatment in either Male or Female Facilities. There is no Library in either male or female facility. On the day of visit the people were not provided with the dinner on time in front of the team as the food did not came from caterers on the day of visit. Evening tea and snack were provided after ask the team to provide them in the evening. No proper care of the people who need help when they need help to use toilet for natural call or even they pass it without intimating in their clothes as one of the person happened to wet his pet there was no assistance or help on time to clean him or change his cloths immediately. It was done after the team asked him to do so. No Proper categorization of the type of their Disability. No proper Vocational training and employment activities. Kumari Patel vs Union Of India on 8 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130640632/ 2 Girls were called by their subject names in the Girls centre without even being called by any calling names as if the said Girls were an experiment/project dummy and not human. Raipur District : There are total 35 beneficiaries (with two children, aged 4 and 7 living with their mothers) in the female Gharaunda centre and 23 beneficiaries in male Gahraunda centre, out of which four have been taken home. During inspection it was found that 07 deaths have occurred in Female Gharaunda Centre whereas 04 deaths have occurred in the Male Gharunda Centre. The PM report of three male beneficiaries has not been received. There are many disabled persons whose parentage or other relations are not known. Therefore, in order to prevent any misuse of body parts of the deceased, it would be proper that before cremation and disposal of the body, it should be certified from a Government Hospital/Doctor that the body parts of the deceased are intact. There is difficulty in preparation of Aadhar Card due to which Unique Disability ID could not be prepared. Both the Gharaunda centres are established in rented premises with two separate and adjacent buildings within a common boundary. There were separate kitchen rooms and store house in both male and female Gharaunda centres. The Dining area and playground are common for both the female and males. There are 20 staff/employees in the female Gharaunda centres whereas 16 staff/employees in the male Gharaunda centres. Timely visits of Physiotherapist, Doctors, Speech Therapist, Yoga trainer is not taking place. Proper categorization of the type of disability is required. Two separate Vocational Trainers are engaged for Vocational training and employment activities. For entertainment facilitates Televisions are installed in the Gharaunda centres. Security guards have been employed in both the male and female Gharaunda centres. Bills of the centres were seen by the team, however, in absence of the ledger account the same cannot be verified. All the staff of both the centres were enquired of their monthly salary and the salary as mentioned in the register was answered by the staff. The staffs were very well accustomed with the beneficiaries and infact the beneficiaries were also very familiar and were found in talking terms with the staff and manager. Kumari Patel vs Union Of India on 8 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130640632/ 3 Bastar District : BUILDING CONDITION That the Aradhana Mental Rehabilitation Center is spread over an area admeasuring 5 Acre comprising of 1 Building, Gaushala (Cow Shelter), Garden and farming area. The land is owned by the Bastar Viklang Sewa Samiti and security is provided by the Home Guard, Department of Home. That the Building is well planned and maintained in terms of design, structure, furniture, toilet and bpaints. It fulfills the criteria laid down in the Guidelines dated 5th March 2019. That CCTV are installed in the building and is in operation. It is further submitted that ramp facility is available for the inhabitants. There are three large halls attached with multiple washroom and bathrooms. There are individual rooms for some patients whose mental health does not permit them to be with others. It is submitted that washroom and bathrooms are cleaned everyday by the sweepers to maintain the hygiene. There are three kitchens operational in the building wherein also cleanliness and hygiene are maintained. All the inhabitants if mental health permits undertake yoga session, watch Television and undertake recreational activities like gym, carrom, gardening. cattle farming, agricultural activities, tailoring, hand weaving etc. APPROVALS UNDER STATUES : It is pertinent to note that Gharaunda Center is exclusively for the Women at present holding 25 inhabitants and majority of Person with Disability admitted in the Center are brought by the Police. It is submitted that Gharaunda Center had been recognized by the State Government for the first time Annexure D-2 of Affidavit of Secretary. Department of Social Welfare dated 21.08.2023) for undertaking the work in relation to person with disability. It is further submitted that the grants were received by the Gharaunda Center for first time in 2020-21 onwards. That the Gharaunda Center is duly registered under Section 50 of The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 vide Letter dated 21 July 2020 issued by Deputy Director, Department of Social Welfare and Section 52 of the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995 vide Letter dated 25 January 2022 Deputy Director, Department of Social Welfare. It is submitted that Gharaunda Center does not holds Certificate of Registration under Section 12 of National Trust Act, 1995 issued by Respondent No.1. AND FOOD That Dr. M. Valsala (MD, Psychiatrist) visits the Gharaunda Center twice or thrice in a fortnight and is available all the time in case of emergency . Further, she had trained the regular staff working in the Gharaunda Kumari Patel vs Union Of India on 8 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130640632/ 4 Center who possess Diploma in Nursing due to which they are competent to administer injections and medicine to the inhabitants. Medicines are administered on regular basis to inhabitants to keep them in peace and sound mind. Medicine stock was available in the Gharaunda Center. It is submitted that inhabitants are provided a healthy and rich diet inchading vegetable and non- vegetarian diet. It is submitted that food quality is good and nutritious which was evident from the health and mood of the inhabitants. Vegetables are grown insale the premises and used for the inhabitants. REGISTERS AND FINANCIAL CONDITION That Gharaunda Center had maintained proper Register of Admission and Death of the inhabitants. It is submitted that most of the inhabitants are orphan due to which Gharaunda Center had got their Aadhar Card prepared by themselves after their admission. Further, I have verified the Death Certificates of the deceased inhabitants which have passed away due to their mental illness. It is submitted that there are very few inhabitants who have returned to their home that too for agricultural work and its registers were also maintained. It is submitted that salaries and wages are paid through Online Banking except for maids and sweepers. Conclusion: "Robert Kanan Bala Smriti Seva Sansthan - Male" substantially justifies the budget allocated to this Center. The Center is comprised of basic necessity but the buildup area of the residential premises is small in comparison to prescribed norms, specially to the part that the Center is having maximum number of beneficiaries (22) with minimum space for them in the residential premises. Apart from residential portion, the space of overall premise was apt.
